title: Felt-Light Mornings v3
description: An intimate, felt-piano house cut in the fred again vein: chopped number-vocal fragments and a lush swpad drift over a brushed LinnDrum groove. Answering the repeated note that the drums are still too loud, this version makes a decisive cut to every drum layer (kick, clap, hats, open hat) and thins the percussion, while lifting the piano, sine sub-bass, swpad and vocal chops so they clearly sit on top.
